note: Generic and named portrait pools of the roster (docs/plans/zin-art/portraits_handoff.md). Numbers and ids only: the images are in art/source/portraits/ (named/, pool/, tranche2/, tranche3/) and are sliced by modules/art.mjs. Pool size is the number of portraits of a culture and sex; a portrait serves at most ceil(characters / size) + 1 characters, never twice in one realm.

named.name: Kusven
named.note: Zol's field marshal, a Great Spirit of the grave-wind (K41, redesign A). A unit leader recruited by the Zol slice (tools/content/modules/mech_zol.mjs); not on the roster.

emblems.name: Zol's Dead emblem
emblems.note: One emblem for the realm of the dead: the Will of Zol sigil on a dark ground, no figure. Shared by the three Zol characters, which the realm rule exempts because no person is shown.
